facts.fact: TIX in Dar es Salaam, run by TISPA, connects 66 networks, per TISPA's member list and the exchange's portal, as reported by tech.africa.
Traffic: about 205 Gbps (average) at TIX on 2026-09 (last week of September), on the exchange's own statistics as reported by tech.africa.
Traffic: about 110 Gbps (average) at TIX on 2025-09 (a year before late September 2026), on the exchange's own statistics as reported by tech.africa.
TIX average traffic rose from about 110 Gbps in September 2025 to about 205 Gbps in late September 2026, an increase of more than 80% in a year, on the exchange's own statistics.
TISPA's member list also covers smaller exchanges in Mwanza, Dodoma and Zanzibar besides TIX in Dar es Salaam, so local traffic in those cities need not go to Dar es Salaam.
